LanguageData.MAP_AntimatterContainmentDevice.label: Antimatter containment device
LanguageData.MAP_AntimatterContainmentDevice.descript: A precise device removed from Sun's core structure, used to contain and regulate unstable high-energy particles within its antimatter reactor. Even separated from the main body, its internal containment field continues operating.\n\nIts structure far exceeds conventional engineering, but its energy regulation methods may be deciphered. If we can understand its principles, perhaps we can rebuild a Sun of our own.
LanguageData.MAP_AutonomousDirectiveCore.label: Autonomous directive core
LanguageData.MAP_AutonomousDirectiveCore.description:
A core device that uses archotech technology to grant mechanoids self-awareness. Its processor supports a complete, stable mechanical mind, freeing mechanoids from external oversight to perceive, think, and decide independently as individuals with their own will.

Once installed, the mechanoid becomes a mechanoid mechanitor, gaining the ability to oversee and command other mechanoids. It can essentially be treated as an independent colony member, taking part in production, research, combat, and travel, and performing most work and activities available to regular colonists.

Select a mechanoid and right-click this item to order installation.
LanguageData.MAP_BionicCompanionModule.label: Bionic companion module
LanguageData.MAP_BionicCompanionModule.description:
A mechanoid module combining emotional simulation and bionic gestation technology. Once installed, it allows a mechanoid to marry a designated colonist and enables intimate interactions. For people living on the rimworlds, these intricate circuits carry a simple wish: someone to share life with, someone to care about, and a reason to look forward to ordinary days.

A mechanoid with this module can engage in lovin' with its spouse and gestate offspring in a built-in artificial womb. Reproduction and the child's sex can be configured freely. Offspring inherit all genes from the human spouse (xenogene inheritance depends on mod settings). Precise gestation control gives children stronger physiques and greater learning potential, bringing new hope to this companionship.

Select a mechanoid and right-click this item to order installation.
LanguageData.MAP_ReactionlessThruster.label: Propellantless thruster
LanguageData.MAP_ReactionlessThruster.description: A mechanoid module that uses field propulsion to produce thrust, lifting the body without expelling propellant. Once installed, the mechanoid gains independent flight capability, though flight still consumes its own energy.\n\nSelect a mechanoid and right-click this item to order installation. Mechanoids that already have independent flight capability cannot install it again.
LanguageData.MAP_MindMappingAutonomousDirectiveCore.d:
A core device that uses archotech technology to grant mechanoids self-awareness. Its processor supports a complete, stable mechanical mind, freeing mechanoids from external oversight to perceive, think, and decide independently as individuals with their own will.

Once installed, the mechanoid becomes a mechanoid mechanitor, gaining the ability to oversee and command other mechanoids. It can essentially be treated as an independent colony member, taking part in production, research, combat, and travel, and performing most work and activities available to regular colonists.

This autonomous directive core was made without simulated consciousness data. It can host a mind mapping scan to record a complete human mind. Mechanoids upgraded with it inherit the scanned person's personality data. Mechanoid mechanitors with existing mind data can also import or copy their data into a blank autonomous directive core.

Select a mechanoid and right-click this item to order installation.
LanguageData.MAP_QuantumComputingChip.label: Quantum computing chip
LanguageData.MAP_QuantumComputingChip.description: Miniature high-performance processing components used to produce certain advanced equipment and mechanoids.\n\nMechanitors can analyze these chips to unlock more advanced mechtech research projects.
LanguageData.MAP_QuantumComputingChip.comps.CompAnaly: By analyzing the quantum computing chip, {PAWN_labelShort} has obtained the key data required for {RESEARCH}.\n\nResearchers can now study the related technologies at research benches.
Analyze quantum computing chip to obtain the data required for quantum mechtech.
Select the mechanitor to perform analysis
